facts.text: Under the Fourth Year Tuition-Free program, full-time undergraduate students who pay tuition for six consecutive semesters receive free tuition for their final two semesters (up to 17 credit hours each).

sources.title: Fourth Year Tuition-Free · Pensacola Christian College
sources.quote: Pay standard tuition for 6 consecutive semesters (3 years) and receive free tuition the 7th and 8th semesters (4th year), up to 17 credit hours per semester.
